doc: The building_shadows band (core/render/README.md 'Cast shadows'): the height cue of the 90-degree city. Every chunk shadow command (a building, prop or parked car silhouette the generator offsets down-right and flags as a shadow) draws on that band with one material: `shader` when it is in the tree (the d5-close lane's look_d5_shadow, its 'shadow' params proposal), else `fallback_shader` (this lane's D4 placeholder, the same uniforms). Both print as a light ink tint plus world-locked hand-drawn pen strokes that the look_d4 print then inks (the hatched cast shadows of the target frame). classes: offset_m = the cast distance down-right per texture class; the chunk data carries baked_offset_m (ChunkBuild.add), the view adds the rest, so no re-bake. by_name: a texture `name` -> its total cast distance (over its class's offset_m): the d5-close hero scene's per-prop lengths (D5HeroPropShadow LENGTH_M, a stylised height; parked cars 0.4 m by class), adopted 2026-11-03. parapet_core_m: the raised-roof read of the target frame (n-d5's D5HeroParapets): ChunkView draws each building's silhouette again in solid ink this far down-right, just above the hatched shadow, so an ink band runs along the roof's down-right edges where they face open ground (0 = off). n5-look 2026-11-04: building offset_m 1.1 -> 0.45 (targets: no long cast shadows; owner round 1 'remove shadows'): a short height cue like the targets' props, no longer a 35 px band at 32 px/m. 0 extra would be 0.25 (the baked offset).
